limitations: Server timing includes all 272 generated tokens; bench excludes 16 warm-up tokens and times 256.
Chat uses a different rendered text prompt; sampled_stream uses temperature 0.8. Neither isolates transport overhead vs the ID bench.
Several server arms remain above 2% spread after the single permitted repeat. No blanket stable-gap or speedup claim.
Qwen first bench control was 42.51 ms/token, later 30.48; two additional warm controls are reported, not substituted silently.
Bytes total_at_ctx is a static capacity-16K byte-traffic model, not measured DRAM bandwidth or actual ~300-token KV traffic.
MTP engine_calls count verify cycles; per-call milliseconds cannot be compared with plain per-token bench timing.

Source audit: bench --batched-prompt prefills all 53 IDs together with logits=false; server splits head and final token and requests logits. Generated bench/server trajectories were not compared. Matching prompt IDs/positions alone does not establish identical trajectories.
